comments.author: @themanifestation.x
comments.text: Watching this fills my heart with so much hope. 🇮🇹 Every street, every view, and every moment makes me dream even harder of living and studying in Italy in 2026. I’m praying for this with all my heart every single day, and not a single moment passes without me imagining my future there. I truly hope that one day I’ll come back to this comment from Italy and smile, knowing that every prayer, every effort, and every bit of faith brought me exactly where I was meant to be. InshaAllah. ❤️

replies.text: @LieveLeysen-Discover- Thank you so much for this beautiful reminder. 🤍 I truly needed to hear this. I’m choosing to trust the journey, do everything I can from my side, and be grateful for every little step along the way. Your words made this dream feel even more real. 🥹🇮🇹✨❤️

replies.text: When you replace hoping by trusting, do everything you can from your side to come the closest possible to your dream, enjoy the journey and say thanks for it from the bottom of your heart as if it has already happened, you will. 😇✨ Have fun❣️
